title: score_intake_request input
description: Records the PMO's demand fields on an intake request that is on the table (submitted, in progress or completed): the score, the size band, the horizon and the expected benefit, as reported. The request keeps its status. Priority is a decision: propose it with save_decision_proposal (decision type priority), and its accountable holder answers it on the decision page. A draft is the requester's to edit with save_intake_draft.

score.description: The PMO score, 0 to 100. Higher comes first in the demand list.

clearScore.description: True clears a score recorded earlier. Leave score out then.

sizeBandKey.description: A rough size, from the size-band value list.

horizonKey.description: Now, next or later, from the horizon value list.

expectedBenefit.description: The benefit, as the PMO records it.
